newsitem.title: UK: Capers flat on freight market, Panamaxes improve.
newsitem.headline: Capers flat on freight market, Panamaxes improve.

text.p: The Caper scene was said to be still flat at the start of the week but Panamax prospects were improving again for April in most areas, brokers reported.
Nearby positions in the US Gulf and to some extent in the North Pacific continued to pose some problems for Panamax owners, but there was general optimism from owners about April onwards.

Demand for tonnage for April loading strengthened in the Far East, Indian Ocean, South Atlantic and US Gulf. Late 1970s-built Panamaxes were said to be seeing close to $10,000 daily for Pacific rounds and mid-1980s-built vessels up to $1,000 more.
There was also more short period enquiry in the market - Cobelfret booked Pacific Prospect 72,800 dwt delivery Japan for 3-5 months at a firmer $12,300 daily. The BFI was up 8 points to 1438.

Grain - On the period timecharter front Continental was linked with Oinoussian Sky 64,564 dwt delivery mid-March Jan for 5-7 months at an undisclosed rate, but other reports suggested the vessel was fixed for a Nopac round only at $10,750/11,000 daily. Marifran was said to have booked Kyrenia 72,746 dwt (ex Forum Victory) delivery mid-March S Africa for 6-8 months at about $10,500 daily.

Brokers reported improving prospects and more chartering enquiry from Argentina for Panamaxes and handies, although fixtures were slow to emerge. Shipmair was believed to have covered their March/April E Coast S America/Continent Panamax requirement and relet Patmos 71,600 dwt, and Alexia 28,843 dwt was fixed from the Plate, all on private terms. Andre booked 23,000/10 maize prompt Plate/Malaysia at $41.00, having originally quoted the business at $35.

Brokers said there was a build-up in enquiry from S Korean charterers for Panamaxes from US Gulf to the Far East. Elsewhere Angelic Spirit 65,767 dwt was understood fixed by Panocean delivery Ulsan retro 7 March trip via NOPAC to Bin Qasim at $10,500 daily, and Grand Moulin fixed about 20,000 bagged grains/flour N France/Red Sea on private terms.

New business today included shipmair 55,000/5 heavy grain Plate and Bahia Blanca or Necochea/Port Klang or Butterworth 1/15 April, Cargill 2.6/3.2m cft Buenos Aires or Bahia Blanca/Gibraltar-Hamburg range 20/30 March, and Andre 27,000 corn Durban/Puerto Cabello 15/25 March, 20,000/5 heavy grain US Gulf/Durban 17/25 March and 25/30,000 corn upriver/Cape Town 20/30 March.

Minerals/handies - coal business was rumoured fixed by K Line with Lucida 69,000 dwt from Indonesia to Japan, the 1978-built Lucija 40,000 dwt delivery Manila via Camphor to Japan by Daiichi at close to $8,000 daily, and Angelina the Great 40,763 dwt delivery New Zealand via Australia to Japan at $9,250 daily plus $15,000 bonus (possibly Nyk). Cho Yang quoted a fresh order for a Panamax for coal US Gulf/Taiwan for 10/20 April. Panocean fixed Olympic Mentor 29,000 dwt delivery Singapore mid-March for a trip via Australia to the Far East at a firmer $8,000 daily.
